recipe_version.title: Korean Soft Tofu Stew
recipe_version.description: Soft tofu simmered in a spicy gochugaru broth with plant kimchi, zucchini, and mushrooms. No egg, no seafood, no meat.

ingredients.name: soft tofu
ingredients.note: two 14 oz tubes or blocks of soft/silken tofu. Handle gently. Soy protein.
ingredients.preparation: drained and cut into large spoonable chunks

ingredients.name: plant kimchi
ingredients.display_name: plant kimchi (no fish sauce, no shrimp)
ingredients.note: REQUIRED seafood-free contract. Buy kimchi labeled vegan/plant, or homemade without fish sauce, shrimp paste, oysters, or anchovy. Chopped. Do not use seafood kimchi.

ingredients.name: gochugaru
ingredients.note: ground chili flakes, not a jarred stew base. Primary heat.

ingredients.name: gochujang
ingredients.note: store-bought paste. Typical commercial gochujang contains soy and wheat. Do not add a seafood-based stew concentrate.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: regular soy sauce. Soy and wheat allergens. All of it goes into the broth.

ingredients.name: toasted sesame oil
ingredients.note: finishing oil only. Sesame allergen. Divided: 1 tsp to start the aromatics, 1 tsp off heat at the end.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: for the onion and zucchini sauté before the broth

ingredients.name: zucchini
ingredients.preparation: halved lengthwise and sliced 1/4 inch thick

ingredients.name: vegetable stock
ingredients.note: plant stock only. Do not use chicken, beef, or seafood stock. Unsalted or low-sodium preferred.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: to loosen the broth if needed

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: divided: start with 1/4 tsp; add up to 1/4 tsp more after tasting the broth with soy sauce already in

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Drain the soft tofu and cut it into large spoonable chunks; leave them on a plate. Roughly chop the plant kimchi. Dice the yellow onion. Halve and slice the zucchini. Remove shiitake stems and slice the caps. Mince the garlic and fresh ginger. Thinly slice the scallions. Measure the gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, neutral oil, vegetable stock, water, sugar, kosher salt, and black pepper. Confirm the kimchi label is plant/vegan with no fish sauce or shrimp. Do not crack any eggs; this stew has no egg garnish.

steps.title: Start the aromatics
steps.body: Heat the neutral oil and 1 tsp of the toasted sesame oil in a 3-to-4-quart pot or deep skillet over medium heat. Add the yellow onion and 1/4 tsp of the kosher salt. Cook, stirring, until the onion softens, about 4 minutes. Add the garlic, fresh ginger, and shiitake mushrooms. Cook until the mushrooms soften and smell fragrant, about 3 minutes. Do not brown hard.

steps.title: Bloom the chili paste and flakes
steps.body: Stir in the gochugaru and gochujang. Cook 1 minute, stirring so the paste coats the vegetables and darkens slightly. These are pantry chili products, not a bottled sundubu concentrate and not a seafood stew base.

steps.title: Build the broth with plant kimchi
steps.body: Add the plant kimchi, zucchini, vegetable stock, water, soy sauce, sugar, black pepper, and the remaining kosher salt only if needed after tasting later. Bring to a lively simmer over medium-high heat, then reduce to medium. Simmer uncovered about 8 minutes, until the zucchini is tender-crisp and the broth tastes spicy, sour, and savory. Do not add fish sauce, shrimp, clams, pork, or beef.

steps.title: Add the soft tofu
steps.body: Slide the soft tofu chunks into the pot. Spoon hot broth over them. Simmer gently, without vigorous boiling that breaks the tofu, about 5 minutes, until the tofu is hot through. Taste the broth. Add the remaining salt only if the soy sauce and kimchi have not already seasoned it enough.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Take the pot off the heat. Stir in the remaining 1 tsp toasted sesame oil. Scatter the scallions over the top. Serve in bowls as a stew: soft tofu, kimchi, zucchini, mushrooms, and spicy broth. No egg on top. No rice is required by this recipe (rice on the side is outside the package). kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: Medium for aromatics and chili bloom. Medium-high to bring the broth up, then medium simmer. Gentle simmer for the tofu. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Zucchini tender-crisp after about 8 minutes of simmer. Soft tofu hot through after about 5 gentle minutes, still in large spoonable chunks, not scrambled. Broth spicy, sour from plant kimchi, savory from soy and gochujang. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: No peanuts, tree nuts, or cashews. Sesame is an allergen token (toasted sesame oil), not a tree nut.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Plant soft-tofu stew. No dairy, no shellfish, no meat, no poultry, no eggs. Plant kimchi is contracted seafood-free. Soy and sesame are present as allergens but HH001 allows soy/sesame. Nuts absent except the sesame oil which is not a banned tree nut under HH001.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Unconditional. No milk, butter, cheese, cream, yogurt, egg, meat, poultry, finfish, or shellfish in the ingredient list. Plant kimchi must stay seafood-free; that is a hard shopping contract, not a skip-the-shrimp note. dairy_free and plant_based are not conditional swaps.
allergen_notes: Soy covers soft tofu, soy sauce, and typical commercial gochujang.
Sesame covers toasted sesame oil (both the start spoon and the finish).

Wheat covers regular soy sauce and typical commercial gochujang. If a cook substitutes certified gluten-free tamari and wheat-free gochujang, that is a different package; this written package lists wheat.
No egg, milk, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish. Plant kimchi is contracted free of fish sauce and shrimp. Meat and poultry are dietary_eligibility classes, not allergen tokens.

scaling_notes.1: One serving: about 7 oz soft tofu (half a 14 oz tube), 6 tbsp chopped plant kimchi, 3/4 cup vegetable stock, 2 tbsp water. Onion: 1/4 small. Zucchini: 1/4. Shiitake: about 1.5 oz. Garlic: 1 clove. Ginger: 1 tsp. Gochugaru: 1.5 tsp. Gochujang: 1 tsp. Soy sauce: 1 tsp. Neutral oil: 1 tsp. Sesame oil: 1/2 tsp total. Scallions: 1. Use a small saucepan so the broth still covers the tofu. Same gentle simmer.
scaling_notes.2: 14 oz soft tofu, 3/4 cup plant kimchi, 1.5 cups stock, half the aromatics and seasonings. 2-quart pot.
scaling_notes.4: As written. 28 oz soft tofu, 1.5 cups plant kimchi, 3 cups stock, 3-to-4-quart pot.
do_not_scale: pot size must shrink with the batch so tofu stays submerged

coverage_contribution: Second Korean meal after gochujang grilled flank steak, as a soft-tofu stew instead of another grilled beef plate. Opens stew texture (soft tofu in spicy fermented-chili broth) without cloning smoky lentil sweet potato stew. HH001 plant path with an explicit seafood-free kimchi contract and no egg (eggs reserved for shakshuka).
near_duplicate_review: Compared with Gochujang Grilled Flank Steak: same Korean/gochujang neighborhood, but that meal is grilled beef with sesame cucumber salad; this is a meat-free soft-tofu stew with plant kimchi. Compared with Teriyaki Tofu Bowls and Crispy Chipotle Tofu Tacos: those are Japanese-inspired glaze bowls and Mexican air-fry tacos; different cuisine, format, and spice system. Compared with Smoky Lentil Sweet Potato Stew: both are stews, but that one is American lentil-sweet-potato; this is Korean soft tofu and kimchi broth. Compared with Coconut Chickpea Curry / Thai red curry slot: different cuisine and no coconut. Not a kimchi fried-rice egg skillet. Not a gochujang salmon.
